Opposite Party
 Mr. P.K. Mohanty, Asc
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh

Order
13.09.2024 Order No.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with C.T(Special) NDPS Case No.18 of 2022 pending on the file of learned ADJ-Cum-Special Court, POCSO, Jharsuguda, arising out of Jharsuguda P.S.
Case No.0111 dtd.21.02.2022 for commission of offence alleged under Sections 376 AB/449 IPC R/W 6/8 POCSO Act.
3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioner relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C by the learned ADJ-cum-PO,Special Court, POCSO, Jharsuguda by order dated 04.04.2024 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. This is the third journey of the Petitioner to this Court.
Earlier the bail applications of the Petitioner were rejected by order dated 21.11.2022 and 26.07.2020 in BLAPL No.6737 of 2022 and 6443 of 2024 respectively.
6. Considering the statement of the victim -P.W.5 as well as the sister-P.W.4, this Court is not inclined to entertain the bail application at this stage.

sentences.text: 1 7. Since the Petitioner is in custody from 22.02.2022, learned Court in seisin is requested to expedite the trial.
8. Learned counsel for the State is called upon impart necessary instruction to produce the witnesses on the date fixed so that the trial does not linger.
Copy of this order be made over to the learned counsel for the State to take necessary follow up action.
9. Registry is requested to do the needful.
10. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge SOUMYA Signed by: SOUMYA RANJAN SAMAL
